class: a red that was already on main read as the change's, the base re-run on every run, or a red recorded in a broken environment carried as pre-existing
caught_by: the base side reads the cache at the base's key before any worktree runs: a pass of any run that covers every red file is inherited, and a named fail only from a whole run's record whose inputs include every path the tier copies, so a red whose failing tests all failed there is carried and any other is newly red against the base. A compared run's records serve passes only. Without a usable record the base runs in a worktree, a change-selected tier's limited to the red files the base has and a whole tier's whole, or is absent: not-run (unmeasured), and every red over it is newly red with basis no-base
missed_by: no base result at all, so a pre-existing red and a new one looked the same
